purpose.role: Preserve the registered bot role; operating job kind never changes registry role or authority.
purpose.hypothesis: State the falsifiable behavior of this operating job, not an unsupported claim of market alpha.
purpose.primary_family: Assign exactly one operating job family. Economic strategy classifications remain separate hints.
purpose.objective: Define the output this exact registry entry or source program is responsible for producing.

scope.universe: Bind exact registry inputs or the source-defined data selection and feature expressions; do not invent instruments.
scope.venue: This component does not own an order venue. Input provider selection belongs to its bound source program.
scope.session: Use the existing caller's invocation/session selection, including source-defined allowlists.
scope.decision_interval_seconds: Declare event-driven invocation explicitly. No polling interval or wall-clock conversion is invented for sample-based programs.
scope.holding_horizon_seconds: This job does not own positions. Prediction horizons remain source-defined observation counts or explicit label-time rules.
scope.inputs: Bind the per-bot input fields, registry record projection, and executable feature builders.

decision_rules.output_rule: Bind the exact source program, entry points and shared helpers, or the registry-slot definition projection.
decision_rules.parameters: Record literal values, exact expressions, function defaults and training-call keyword arguments without executing code.
decision_rules.position_management: Entry/add/trim/exit/time-stop ownership stays with existing position, risk and execution controllers; this job grants none.
decision_rules.test_cases: Require valid-binding acceptance and changed-identity rejection cases for the definition controller. Model conformance tests are separate.

abstention.conditions: Reject missing, changed, ambiguous or authority-bearing definition bindings; model sample rejection remains the bound source logic.
abstention.maximum_input_age_seconds: Use source-defined input/label freshness rules for model calls. Definition source identity is rechecked on each native audit.
abstention.supported_regimes: Describe declared source filters exactly. A registry regime label alone is not empirical evidence of model support.

boundaries.owner: The bot-organization controller owns these definitions; the existing trainer or collector retains execution of its own work.
boundaries.allowed_outputs: Limit this definition layer to contracts and audit evidence. Describe model or metadata outputs without activating them.
boundaries.forbidden_actions: No orders, allocation, risk-limit changes, registry mutation, promotion, worker creation, or profitability clearance.
boundaries.risk_owner: Downstream decisions retain the existing institutional and execution-lane owners and all vetoes.
boundaries.dependencies: Pin direct local imports and explicit shared feature, label, training and execution-boundary sources.

training.target: Bind the exact implemented learning target, or explicitly identify a metadata-only slot with no dedicated trainer.
training.label_horizon_seconds: Keep label maturity declarations separate from sample-count horizons. Do not infer seconds from a strategy name.
training.join_policy: Record implemented source/registry label joins; their statistical correctness is not established by definition completeness.
training.split_policy: Record the implemented split/defaults and preserve synthetic-versus-runtime origin; do not fabricate purged validation.
training.experiment_contract: Bind the bot, code revision and definition receipt. Candidate, dataset, model and untouched evaluation evidence remain separate requirements.

accountability.metric: Measure operating-contract correctness and describe source loss/metrics separately from net trading returns.
accountability.benchmark: Use the exact source/record projection as the operating benchmark; a strategy benchmark requires the separate trading mandate.
accountability.invalidation: Any identity, role, contract, source, dependency or authority mismatch makes the operating definition incomplete.
accountability.trace_fields: Publish bot ID, definition digest, profile, source and registry receipts, all seven areas, validation issues and separate evidence states.
accountability.lifecycle: Define draft, source-bound, changed/incomplete, and retired-record handling without mutating runtime lifecycle.

collection_wrapper.purpose: Describe the registered collection specification and return its existing blocked-training metadata.
collection_wrapper.hypothesis: describe_bot returns its declared BOT_SPEC; train_brain returns metadata with trainable_now false through the existing collection helper.

registry_declared_slot.purpose: Represent an explicitly bound registry research/collection slot with no dedicated source program.
registry_declared_slot.hypothesis: The definition projection preserves this bot's explicit registry metadata and exposes the absence of a dedicated implementation.

runtime_model_program.purpose: Fit or describe a model using the source program's runtime-data training path and its exact feature, label and filter callbacks.
runtime_model_program.hypothesis: The model learning procedure predicts the target produced by the pinned label program from the pinned feature program; test loss and generalization must be measured independently.

synthetic_research_program.purpose: Run the source-defined synthetic or offline research experiment without treating simulated results as live market evidence.
synthetic_research_program.hypothesis: The source-defined predictor or classifier fits its generated or offline dataset under the pinned training procedure; synthetic fit does not establish market alpha.
